items.name: font-aclonica

items.name: font-acme

items.description: Acme is a condensed display typeface inspired by the visual language of classic cartoons and comics. It is designed to be used in headlines, and has a particular and groovy rhythm.

items.name: font-actor
items.title: Actor
items.description: A diploma thesis project from the Aachen University of Applied Sciences at Karl-Friedrich (Kai) Oetzbach. The font originated in a course in type design.

items.name: font-adamina
items.title: Adamina
items.description: Adamina is a typeface designed for text setting in small sizes. For this purpose the x-height is increased and contrast lowered. Proportions are transitional and compact.

items.name: font-adlam-display
items.title: ADLaM Display
items.description: To help address the lack of display typefaces for the ADLaM script, invented by Ibrahima and Abdoulaye Barry, Microsoft commissioned three renowned type designers Neil Patel, Mark Jamra, and Andrew Footit to create ADLaM Display.

items.name: font-advent-pro
items.title: Advent Pro
items.description: Advent Pro is a modern font designed for web and print. Advent Pro utilizes some of the universal characteristics of the sans-serif genre with modern characteristics to give an edge to your typography.

items.name: font-afacad
items.title: Afacad
items.description: Afacad, a sans typeface by Kristian Möller, Dicotype.

items.name: font-afacad-flux
items.title: Afacad Flux
items.description: Afacad Flux, a sans typeface by Kristian Möller, Dicotype.

items.name: font-agbalumo
items.title: Agbalumo
items.description: Curvy, chunky, and compact. The Agbalumo display typeface has been designed to represent and capture the beauty of African languages.

items.name: font-agdasima
items.title: Agdasima
items.description: Agdasima is a DocRepair font, intended to improve compliance with the ISO/IEC 29500 standard by providing fallback for Agency FB that minimizes text reflow in Office Open XML documents.

items.name: font-agrave-pro
items.title: Agrave Pro
items.description: Agrave Pro, a handwritten typeface by Daan Jobsis.

items.name: font-agu-display
items.title: Agu Display
items.description: Agu Display, a display typeface by Seun Badejo.

items.name: font-aguafina-script
items.title: Aguafina Script
items.description: Semi-formal and eye-catching elegance is the name of the game, says Aguafina Script. Graceful, but not too casual. Knowledgeable and artistic, but not too imposing.

items.name: font-akatab
items.title: Akatab
items.description: Akatab is a Unicode font for rendering Tifinagh characters in the Tamahaq, Tamashek and Tawallamat languages. This font uses state-of-the-art OpenType font technology to provide accurate typography including the formation of bi-consonant...

items.name: font-akaya-kanadaka
items.title: Akaya Kanadaka
items.description: Akaya is a single weight experimental display typeface in Kannada, Telugu and Latin scripts. Akaya Kanadaka and Akaya Telivigala are made as two separate font files which share a common Latin.

items.name: font-akaya-telivigala
items.title: Akaya Telivigala
items.description: Akaya is a single weight experimental display typeface in Kannada, Telugu and Latin scripts. Akaya Telivigala and Akaya Kanadaka are made as two separate font files which share a common Latin.

items.name: font-akronim
items.title: Akronim
items.description: Akronim is a brand-new, original, brush like, stylish font with a Western and Central European (e.g. Polish, Croatian, Czech, Magyar etc.) Latin character set. Handmade in Poland, Europe, by Grzegorz Klimczewski.

items.name: font-akshar
items.title: Akshar
items.description: Akshar is a variable display sans-serif font family that supports Latin and Devanagari. It is designed for titles, statements, headlines, annoucements, intros, outros, and other display texts.

items.name: font-akt
items.title: Akt
items.description: Akt, a sans typeface by Dmitry Grenev.

items.name: font-aladin
items.title: Aladin
items.description: Aladin is a calligraphic vintage face with a middle eastern touch, designed by Angel Koziupa and produced by Alejandro Paul. Casual, airy counters and friendly terminals give it an advantage as a packaging font for exotic coffees and teas.

items.name: font-alan-sans
items.title: Alan Sans
items.description: Alan Sans, a sans typeface by Raphaël Ronot, Samar Zureik.

items.name: font-alata
items.title: Alata
items.description: Alata is a geometric low contrast sans design. It can feel monumental, serious and archaic and occasionally eccentric. It draws inspiration from both Early 20th C poster lettering and epigraphic Greek mono line letters.

items.name: font-alatsi
items.title: Alatsi
items.description: Alatsi is an original typeface designed by Spyros Zevelakis. It is a semicondensed geometric sans design which feels familiar, calm, trustable and contemporary. It is a little lighthearted or casual in feeling as well.

items.name: font-albert-sans
items.title: Albert Sans
items.description: Albert Sans is a modern geometric sans serif family, inspired by the type-characteristics of scandinavian architects and designers in the early 20th century.

items.name: font-aldrich
items.title: Aldrich
items.description: Aldrich is a rounded yet squarely proportioned font that is reminiscent of early 20th Century gothic styles. With a solid stance and confident mono-weight strokes, Aldrich is a hardworking family with roots in Midwestern ethics.

items.name: font-alef
items.title: Alef
items.description: Alef was born in the screen and designed to the pixel in an attempt to extend the palette of Hebrew fonts available for web design. It challenges the default, Arial. Alef supports both the Hebrew and Latin writing systems.

items.name: font-alegreya
items.title: Alegreya
items.description: Alegreya was chosen as one of 53 "Fonts of the Decade" at the ATypI Letter2 competition in September 2011, and one of the top 14 text type systems.

items.name: font-alegreya-sans
items.title: Alegreya Sans
items.description: Alegreya Sans is a humanist sans serif family with a calligraphic feeling that conveys a dynamic and varied rhythm. This gives a pleasant feeling to readers of long texts. There is also a Small Caps companion family.

items.name: font-alegreya-sans-sc
items.title: Alegreya Sans SC
items.description: Alegreya Sans SC is a Small Caps companion family to Alegreya Sans, a humanist sans serif family with a calligraphic feeling that conveys a dynamic and varied rhythm. This gives a pleasant feeling to readers of long texts.

items.name: font-alegreya-sc
items.title: Alegreya SC
items.description: Alegreya was chosen as one of 53 "Fonts of the Decade" at the ATypI Letter2 competition in September 2011, and one of the top 14 text type systems.

items.name: font-aleo
items.title: Aleo
items.description: Aleo is a contemporary typeface designed by Alessio Laiso as the slab serif companion to the Lato font by Łukasz Dziedzic.

items.name: font-alex-brush
items.title: Alex Brush
items.description: Alex Brush is a beautifully flowing brush script. It has short ascenders and descenders allowing a legibility not seen in other script fonts. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support.

items.name: font-alexandria
items.title: Alexandria
items.description: Alexandria is the Arabic companion of Montserrat, a Latin script typeface designed by Julieta Ulanovsky which was inspired by the old posters and signs in the traditional Montserrat neighborhood of Buenos Aires.

items.name: font-alfa-slab-one
items.title: Alfa Slab One
items.description: Alfa Slab One is a contemporary take on the Six-lines Pica Egyptian created by Robert Thorne for the Thorowgood Foundry in 1921.

items.name: font-alice
items.title: Alice
items.description: Ksenia Erulevich, designer of the Alice typeface, was inspired by Lewis Carrol's novel and decided to make a typeface that will be suitable for typesetting that book.

items.name: font-alien-block
items.title: Alien Block
items.description: Alien Block, a display typeface by Kensuke Uchida.

items.name: font-alike
items.title: Alike
items.description: Alike is a text typeface with expressive and tense letterforms. Its design features are said to have Czech influence, but are softened for a friendlier feel.

items.name: font-alike-angular
items.title: Alike Angular
items.description: Alike Angular is a complementary titling style to Alike. It shares the same proportions as its counterpart for compatibility, and is designed for larger display sizes.

items.name: font-alkalami
items.title: Alkalami
items.description: Alkalami is the local word for the Arabic "qalam", a type of sharpened stick used for writing on wooden boards in the Kano region of Nigeria and in Niger, and what gives the style its distinct appearance.

items.name: font-alkatra
items.title: Alkatra
items.description: A display typeface family comprising of Bangla, Devanagari, Odia and Latin Each typeface for each script has been designed keeping in mind the inspiration of drawing letters for wall graffitis in Bengal, India, by using a stick and tar.

items.name: font-allan
items.title: Allan
items.description: Once Allan was a sign painter in Berlin. Grey paneling work in the subway, bad materials, a city split in two. Now things have changed.

items.name: font-allerta
items.title: Allerta
items.description: Allerta is an open source typeface designed for use in signage. Allerta was designed to be easily and quickly read from a distance.

items.name: font-allerta-stencil

items.name: font-allison

items.description: Allison is a casual handwriting script. The lowercase forms carry an obvious flat pen calligraphic influence while the uppercase letters are more brushy in style.

items.name: font-allura

items.description: The casual characters of Allura are simple, clean and very legible. The script and formal sets offer a softer, more formal look. Allura was designed with advertising, display and package design in mind.

items.name: font-almarai

items.description: Almarai is a modern Arabic and sans serif Latin typeface family in 4 weights. The font was created by Boutros™ for optimal readability and suitability for both online and offline applications.

items.name: font-almendra

items.description: Anta, a modern font family, is intelligently designed for screen publications. Anta Typeface has several interesting, constructed glyph shapes that give the typeface a modern look.

items.name: font-antic
items.title: Antic
items.description: Antic is the result of studying calligraphic forms, and is designed to be used for running text. This started two big text type family projects and this is the first one.

items.name: font-antic-didone
items.title: Antic Didone
items.description: Antic Didone was designed for use in the headlines of newspapers and magazines. The Antic Type System is a super family that is still evolving, and this first release of the Didone family.

items.name: font-antic-slab
items.title: Antic Slab
items.description: Antic Slab was designed for use in the headlines of newspapers and magazines. The Antic Type System is a super family that is still evolving, and this first release of the Slab family.

items.title: Anton

items.name: font-anton-sc
items.title: Anton SC
items.description: Anton is a reworking of a traditional advertising sans serif typeface. The letter forms have been digitised and then reshaped for use as a webfont, the counters have been opened up a little and the stems optimised for use as bold display...

items.name: font-antonio
items.title: Antonio
items.description: Antonio is a 'refined' version of the Anton Font. Anton is a single weight web font, designed specifically for larger display, headline and 'banner' use (see Google's PR for the Chromebook notebooks that used Anton, big and bright).

items.name: font-anuphan
items.title: Anuphan
items.description: Anuphan is a loopless version of IBM Plex Thai developed by Mint Tantisuwanna, a type designer at Cadson Demak. This project is intended for self-improvement/educational purpose. Note: This is not a modification of IBM Plex Sans Thai.

items.name: font-anybody
items.title: Anybody
items.description: Anybody is a big family that combines an affinity for Eurostile plus a heavy dose of 90s inspiration. It's flexible enough to adapt to a variety of situations.

items.name: font-aoboshi-one
items.title: Aoboshi One

items.name: font-ar-one-sans
items.title: AR One Sans
items.description: AR One Sans is a type family for use in augmented reality environments and user interfaces. The family's low contrast, generous spacing and robust shapes make it work well in busy backgrounds with high readability.

items.name: font-arapey
items.title: Arapey

items.name: font-arbutus
items.title: Arbutus
items.description: Arbutus is a sturdy, medium contrast, slab serif typeface with a faceted/spiked treatment inspired by American wood type.

items.name: font-arbutus-slab
items.title: Arbutus Slab
items.description: Arbutus Slab is a sturdy, medium contrast, slab serif typeface inspired by 18th and 19th American jobbing type. The generous spacing found in this design means that it can be used at fairly small sizes which makes it surprisingly versatile.

items.name: font-architects-daughter
items.title: Architects Daughter
items.description: Inspired by the writing of the daughter of an architect (surprise, surprise!), this font incorporates the graphic, squared look of architectural writing, combined with the natural feel of daily handwriting.

items.name: font-archivo
items.title: Archivo
items.description: Archivo is a grotesque sans serif typeface family originally designed for highlights and headlines. This family is reminiscent of late nineteenth century American typefaces.

items.name: font-archivo-black
items.title: Archivo Black
items.description: Archivo Black was designed to be used simultaneously in print and digital platforms. The technical and aesthetic characteristics of the font are both crafted for high performance typography.

items.name: font-archivo-narrow
items.title: Archivo Narrow
items.description: Archivo Narrow was designed to be used simultaneously in print and digital platforms. The technical and aesthetic characteristics of the font are both crafted for high performance typography.

items.name: font-are-you-serious
items.title: Are You Serious

items.name: font-aref-ruqaa
items.title: Aref Ruqaa

items.name: font-aref-ruqaa-ink
items.title: Aref Ruqaa Ink
items.description: Aref Ruqaa Ink is an Arabic typeface that aspires to capture the essence of the classical Ruqaa calligraphic style. This font uses the COLRv1, CPAL and SVG tables.

items.name: font-arima
items.title: Arima
items.description: A display font with soft edges and calligraphic feel is the main inspiration for Arima project. It has a low contrast to allow good rendering on screen.

items.name: font-arimo

items.description: Arimo was designed by Steve Matteson as an innovative, refreshing sans serif design that is metrically compatible with Arial™.

items.name: font-arizonia
items.title: Arizonia
items.description: Arizonia was inspired by the lettering found on a construction truck. It has a sign-painterly appearance which features thick and contrasting stokes that have been painted by a pointed brush.

items.name: font-armata
items.title: Armata
items.description: Armata is a low contrast sans serif text face, with a mixture of familiar and unfamiliar shapes. The steadiness and strength is juxtaposed with some innovative and delicate gestures. Armata can be used in a wide range of sizes.

items.name: font-arsenal

items.name: font-arsenal-sc

items.description: BJCree, a serif typeface by SIL International.

items.name: font-black-and-white-picture
items.title: Black And White Picture
items.description: Black And White Picture is a Korean font that expresses the nostalgia of faded black and white photos through its old and scratchy texture. A matching Latin font, Flavors, is built-in for convenience.

items.name: font-black-han-sans
items.title: Black Han Sans
items.description: Black Han Sans is a new Korean Hangul typeface based on ZBLACK Original. With adjustments to the spacing between letters, this typeface has more structurally unified heights and widths.

items.name: font-black-ops-one
items.title: Black Ops One
items.description: Black Ops One is a low contrast, semi geometric typeface inspired by military stencil lettering. It is heavy, sturdy, punchy, and looks best when used at medium to large sizes because of the small cuts found in stencils.

items.name: font-blaka
items.title: Blaka
items.description: Blaka is an experimental typeface, enriching the gothic feeling of Black Letters by enhancing the geometric features to create midgrounds with the Kufic style for the Arabic letterforms.

items.name: font-blaka-hollow
items.title: Blaka Hollow
items.description: Blaka is an experimental typeface, enriching the gothic feeling of Black Letters by enhancing the geometric features to create midgrounds with the Kufic style for the Arabic letterforms.

items.name: font-blaka-ink
items.title: Blaka Ink
items.description: Blaka is an experimental typeface, enriching the gothic feeling of Black Letters by enhancing the geometric features to create midgrounds with the Kufic style for the Arabic letterforms.

items.name: font-blinker
items.title: Blinker
items.description: Blinker is a low contrast sans serif typeface with a squircle as its basic shape, think squarish curves, or Eurostyle’s flamboyant cousin. It’s best used for medium to large text, rather than a long copy.

items.name: font-bodoni-moda
items.title: Bodoni Moda
items.description: Bodoni Moda is a no-compromises Bodoni family, built for the digital age. This font family includes a full range of weights, italics, an extended character set, OpenType features, and optical sizes, totalling 64 font files.

items.name: font-bodoni-moda-sc
items.title: Bodoni Moda SC
items.description: Bodoni Moda is a no-compromises Bodoni family, built for the digital age. This font family includes a full range of weights, italics, an extended character set, OpenType features, and optical sizes, totalling 64 font files.

items.name: font-bokor
items.title: Bokor
items.description: Bokor is a display Khmer font, suitable for headlines, titles, subtitles, and even banner designs. To contribute, see github.com/danhhong/Bokor.

items.name: font-boldonse
items.title: Boldonse
items.description: Boldonse, a display typeface by Universitype.

items.name: font-bona-nova
items.title: Bona Nova
items.description: Bona Nova is a digitisation of Bona, a cursive typeface designed in 1971 by Andrzej Heidrich — the creator of Polish banknotes.

items.name: font-bona-nova-sc
items.title: Bona Nova SC
items.description: Bona Nova is a digitisation of Bona, a cursive typeface designed in 1971 by Andrzej Heidrich — the creator of Polish banknotes.

items.name: font-bonbon
items.title: Bonbon
items.description: Bonbon is a fancy handwriting font for cheerful and bright headlines. The letterforms are artistic and naive as if they are written in a teenage girl's diary. It is drawn with a fine marker by author Ksenia Erulevich.

items.name: font-bonheur-royale
items.title: Bonheur Royale
items.description: It's casual and contemporary. BonheurRoyale has the look of a calligraphic hand with a slightly brush feel. The contrast of this and thin strokes gives this clean style a legible quality.

items.name: font-boogaloo
items.title: Boogaloo
items.description: Boogaloo was started in 2010 as a complement to the Salsa typeface, while thinking about type used in Latin American music genres and the culture's own identity.

items.name: font-borel
items.title: Borel
items.description: Borel, a handwritten typeface by Rosalie Wagner.

items.name: font-bowlby-one
items.title: Bowlby One
items.description: Bowlby One has been designed for use as a utilitarian, all caps display font. A version with lowercase characters is also available. Its forms are a fusion of a handfull of designs scanned from old, early Twentieth Century type specimens.

items.name: font-bowlby-one-sc
items.title: Bowlby One SC
items.description: Bowlby One SC is designed for use as a utilitarian, All Caps and Small Caps display font. A version with lowercase characters is also available.

items.name: font-bpmf-huninn
items.title: Bpmf Huninn
items.description: Bpmf Huninn, a sans typeface by But Ko, justfont.

items.name: font-bpmf-iansui
items.title: Bpmf Iansui
items.description: Bpmf Iansui, a handwritten typeface by But Ko.

items.name: font-braah-one
items.title: Braah One
items.description: Braah is a display font that perfectly blends boldness and playfulness. The font is available with corresponding Latin/Gurmukhi scripts, making it versatile and adaptable to different languages.

items.name: font-brawler
items.title: Brawler
items.description: Brawler is a compact typeface with sharp features and a sturdy character, designed for comfortable reading in small sizes. It was initially planned as a typeface for newspapers and tabloids.

items.name: font-bree-serif
items.title: Bree Serif
items.description: This friendly upright italic is the serif cousin of TypeTogether's award winning family Bree. Designed by Veronika Burian and José Scaglione, Bree was originally released in 2008 and became an immediate success because of its originality...

items.name: font-bricolage-grotesque
items.title: Bricolage Grotesque
items.description: Bricolage Grotesque is a collage of lots of different things: historical sources, technical decisions and personal feelings. It started as a fork of Mayenne Sans, an open-source single weight font designed by Jérémy Landes (Studio Triple).

items.name: font-briem-hand
items.title: Briem Hand
items.description: Briem Hand is elegant while also being quite accessible and very legible. It is direct and sincere without being excessively sentimental. It provides a range of weights, and comes with and without guides and joins.

items.name: font-bruno-ace
items.title: Bruno Ace
items.description: Bruno Ace draws inspiration from modern automotive logos. This techno geometric sans has a wide stance with a tall x-height for a strong look and appeal. Both a normal case and small caps font exists.

items.name: font-bruno-ace-sc
items.title: Bruno Ace SC
items.description: Bruno Ace draws inspiration from modern automotive logos. This techno geometric sans has a wide stance with a tall x-height for a strong look and appeal. Both a normal case and small caps font exists.

items.name: font-brygada-1918
items.title: Brygada 1918
items.description: Brygada 1918 is a revival project created for the celebration of the 100 years of independance of the Republic of Poland in 2018, with the support of the "Independent" program and the President of the Republic of Poland.

items.name: font-bubblegum-sans
items.title: Bubblegum Sans
items.description: Bubblegum Sans is upbeat, flavor-loaded, brushalicious letters for the sunny side of the street. It bounces with joy and tells a great story.

items.name: font-bubbler-one
items.title: Bubbler One
items.description: Bubbler One is an original font with thin strokes that are particularly straight. It is a legible typeface in small sizes. You can use Bubbler One for any kind of text, formal or informal, big or small; I hope you find it useful!

items.name: font-buda
items.title: Buda
items.description: Against the typographical grey, Buda is a black and white typeface. The letters are shared by two contrasting weights, which clash and balance each other out.

items.name: font-buenard
items.title: Buenard
items.description: Buenard is a high-quality serif typeface for art books. It is based on the Transitional Roman classical structure, with less contrasted strokes and heavier serifs.

items.name: font-bungee
items.title: Bungee
items.description: Bungee, a display typeface by David Jonathan Ross.

items.name: font-bungee-color
items.title: Bungee Color
items.description: In the crowded urban environment, space for signage is always at a premium. From dumpy liquor stores to majestic theaters, sometimes signs have nowhere to go but up. Bungee is a font family that celebrates urban signage.

items.name: font-bungee-hairline
items.title: Bungee Hairline
items.description: Bungee Hairline, a display typeface by David Jonathan Ross.

items.name: font-bungee-inline
items.title: Bungee Inline
items.description: Bungee Inline, a display typeface by David Jonathan Ross.

items.name: font-bungee-outline

items.name: font-bungee-shade

items.name: font-bungee-spice
items.title: Bungee Spice
items.description: Bungee Spice, a display typeface by David Jonathan Ross.

items.name: font-bungee-tint
items.title: Bungee Tint
items.description: Bungee Tint, a display typeface by David Jonathan Ross.

items.name: font-butcherman
items.title: Butcherman
items.description: Butcherman is a zombified display font, hacked and chopped and left for dead, yet still crawling.

items.name: font-butterfly-kids
items.title: Butterfly Kids
items.description: Cute and flirty, Butterfly Kids flits about spreading cheer! Be fun. Be cute. Be happy!

items.name: font-bytesized
items.title: Bytesized
items.description: Bytesized, a sans typeface by Baltdev.

items.name: font-caacupe-one
items.title: Caacupe One
items.description: Caacupe One, a display typeface by Magdalena Alonso Rebollo.

items.name: font-cabin
items.title: Cabin
items.description: Cabin is a humanist sans inspired by Edward Johnston's and Eric Gill's typefaces, with a touch of modernism. Cabin incorporates modern proportions, optical adjustments, and some elements of the geometric sans.

items.name: font-cabin-condensed
items.title: Cabin Condensed
items.description: This is the condensed set of styles of the Cabin font family. The compete family is available as a variable font, with a Weight range from Regular to Bold, and a Width range from Normal to Condensed.

items.name: font-cabin-sketch
items.title: Cabin Sketch
items.description: The Cabin Font is a humanist sans inspired by Edward Johnston’s and Eric Gill’s typefaces, with a touch of modernism. Cabin incorporates modern proportions, optical adjustments, and some elements of the geometric sans.

items.name: font-caesar-dressing
items.title: Caesar Dressing
items.description: Caesar Dressing is a 'Markers' take on a Greek alphabet. Open Window fonts gravitate towards more experimental or spontaneous renderings and this one doesn't look out of place next to the most experimental of those.

items.name: font-cagliostro
items.title: Cagliostro
items.description: Cagliostro was inspired by the early 20th Century lettering work of Ozwald Bruce Cooper. Care was taken to preserve the original hand-lettered feel of his work while updating the style for modern use.

items.name: font-cairo
items.title: Cairo
items.description: Cairo is a contemporary multilingual typeface family. Mohamed Gaber extended the Latin typeface family Titillum Web to support the Arabic script, with a design that is based on the Kufi calligraphic style. Now available as a variable font.

items.name: font-cairo-play
items.title: Cairo Play
items.description: Cairo Play is a color font version of Cairo which features colored marks. This font uses the COLRv0 and CPAL tables. Please visit the gf-guide color page to learn more about Color Fonts technology.

items.name: font-cal-sans
items.title: Cal Sans
items.description: Cal Sans, a sans typeface by Mark Davis, Cal.com Inc..

items.name: font-cal-sans-text-ui
items.title: Cal Sans Text UI
items.description: Cal Sans Text UI, a sans typeface by Mark Davis, Cal.com Inc..

items.name: font-caladea
items.title: Caladea
items.description: Caladea is a free modern, friendly serif font family based on Cambo, designed by Carolina Giovagnoli and Andrés Torresi for HT Fonts. Caladea has the following differences: More condensed width New metrics 4 styles.

items.name: font-calistoga
items.title: Calistoga
items.description: Calistoga is a cheerful, space saving display typeface. It was inspired by Oscar M. Bryn's lettering as seen on the posters made for the Western US based Santa Fe Railroad. Its vintage railroad flavor is found in the whole design.

items.name: font-calligraffitti
items.title: Calligraffitti
items.description: Calligraffitti by Open Window owes its credit to mom and all her years of Calligraphic experience. This impromptu rendering of her calligraphic alphabet captures her years or formal practice blended with a rare encounter with the mood...

items.name: font-cambay
items.title: Cambay
items.description: Cambay is a libre Devanagari typeface family designed to match the Latin Cantarell. It comes in two weights, Regular and Bold, in upright and oblique styles.

items.name: font-cambo
items.title: Cambo
items.description: Cambo is a modern Latin typeface inspired by the contrast, style and ornaments of Khmer typefaces and writing styles. Its main objective is to be used to write Latin texts in a Khmer context, but it is also an elegant choice for all kinds...

items.name: font-candal
items.title: Candal
items.description: Candal is an original and fun sans serif type design by Vernon Adams which was inspired by historical types.

items.name: font-cantarell
items.title: Cantarell
items.description: The Cantarell typeface family was designed during Dave Crossland's study of MA Typeface Design in 2009 in the Department of Typography at the University of Reading (UK).

items.name: font-cantata-one
items.title: Cantata One
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Cantata One is a high contrast extended Didone style text face. In addition to being useful in medium to large text sizes, Cantata One is meant to evoke luxury when used in display sizes.

items.name: font-cantora-one
items.title: Cantora One
items.description: Cantora ('Singer' in Spanish) is a friendly semi formal, semi condensed, semi sans serif. It has reminiscences of hand lettering, mixing straight and bowed stems, and natural curves.

items.name: font-caprasimo
items.title: Caprasimo
items.description: Caprasimo is a DocRepair font, intended to improve compliance with the ISO/IEC 29500 standard by providing fallback for Cooper Black that minimizes text reflow in Office Open XML documents.

items.name: font-capriola
items.title: Capriola
items.description: Capriola is a sans-serif typeface whose unique style draws upon forms seen in handwriting and italic types. Skeletons of the most characteristic glyphs are inspired by quick handwriting and based on a single hand movement (G,a,g,k,e).

items.name: font-caramel
items.title: Caramel
items.description: The Caramel Family is a fun, hand lettered script with three variations that are combined in the latest version of the font. Use alternates and style sets to customize your work.

items.name: font-carattere
items.title: Carattere
items.description: Carattere is a beautiful italic style that is perfect for invitations and other uses where formal elegance and beauty are essential. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support.

items.name: font-cardo
items.title: Cardo
items.description: Cardo is a large Unicode font specifically designed for the needs of classicists, Biblical scholars, medievalists, and linguists. It also works well for general typesetting in situations where a high-quality Old Style font is appropriate.

items.name: font-carlito
items.title: Carlito
items.description: Carlito is a font designed derived from Lato (also designed by Łukasz Dziedzic) that is metric-compatible with Calibri. It comes with Latin and Cyrillic character sets. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/carlito

items.name: font-carme
items.title: Carme
items.description: Carme (Version 1.0) is a clean sans-serif font, specially designed for texts. It contains 206 glyphs and it was given visual metrics and kerning. The bold version is about to be released.

items.name: font-carrois-gothic
items.title: Carrois Gothic
items.description: Carrois Gothic is a well balanced and modern gothic type family. Clean and beautiful. What more do you need? There is the Small Caps sister family too, useful for all noble and significant applications. Learn more at carrois.com

items.name: font-carrois-gothic-sc
items.title: Carrois Gothic SC
items.description: Carrois Gothic is a well balanced and modern gothic type family. Clean and beautiful. What more do you need? This is the Small Caps sister family to the regular family, useful for all noble and significant applications.

items.name: font-carter-one
items.title: Carter One
items.description: Carter is a reworking of particular casual typeforms that were popular around the mid Twentieth Century, often found used areas such advertising or pulp fiction book covers.

items.name: font-cascadia-code
items.title: Cascadia Code
items.description: Cascadia Code, a sans typeface by Aaron Bell, Mohamad Dakak, Viktoriya Grabowska, Liron Lavi Turkenich.

items.name: font-cascadia-mono
items.title: Cascadia Mono
items.description: Cascadia Mono, a sans typeface by Aaron Bell, Mohamad Dakak, Viktoriya Grabowska, Liron Lavi Turkenich.

items.name: font-castoro
items.title: Castoro
items.description: Castoro, a serif typeface by Tiro Typeworks, John Hudson, Paul Hanslow, Kaja Słojewska.

items.name: font-castoro-titling
items.title: Castoro Titling
items.description: Castoro Titling is an all-caps font in which the uppercase of the Castoro text typeface has been ‘re-hung’ on the proportions of Roman inscriptional letters. These lighter, elegant forms are ideal for larger sizes.

items.name: font-catamaran
items.title: Catamaran
items.description: Catamaran is a Unicode-compliant Latin and Tamil text type family designed for the digital age. The Tamil is monolinear and was designed alongside the sans serif Latin and Devanagari family Palanquin.

items.name: font-caudex
items.title: Caudex
items.description: Caudex is a Unicode TrueType font created with FontForge. It is developed on SourceForge. It includes most of the Medieval Unicode Font Initiative (MUFI) version 3.0 recommendations.

items.name: font-cause
items.title: Cause
items.description: Cause, a handwritten typeface by Saurabh Sharma.

items.name: font-caveat
items.title: Caveat
items.description: Caveat is a handwriting type family designed by Pablo Impallari. It is designed for both short annotations and body text usage.

items.name: font-caveat-brush
items.title: Caveat Brush
items.description: Caveat is a handwriting type family designed by Pablo Impallari. It is designed for short annotations. For a different style, there is also a sister family, Caveat The fonts have OpenType features that enable the letters to have slight...

items.name: font-cedarville-cursive
items.title: Cedarville Cursive
items.description: This font is based on the handwriting of a perky, cheerful young preschool teacher. From her love of her Cedarville University alma mater to her passion for her students, she is a delightful, dependable person.

items.name: font-ceviche-one
items.title: Ceviche One
items.description: Ceviche One is a bold expressionist sans. Tasty, wild and delicious curves are inspired in lettering from the 1960s. Ceviche One is a great and dynamic option for large headlines, displays and posters.

items.name: font-chakra-petch
items.title: Chakra Petch
items.description: Chakra Petch is a Thai and Latin family which features Thai's traditional looped letterforms. It's a square sans serif with tapered corners. Due to the design, it works well for both digital and print based media.

items.name: font-changa
items.title: Changa
items.description: Changa is intended for text usage, with its short ascenders and descenders and a set of lowercase letters inscribed within a square.

items.name: font-changa-one
items.title: Changa One
items.description: Changa One is intended for titles, with its short ascenders and descenders and a set of lowercase letters inscribed within a square.

items.name: font-chango
items.title: Chango
items.description: Chango is a display face based on letters drawn by Mexican illustrator Ernesto “Chango” García Cabral. It’s big and heavy, ideal for head-line body sizes with a humorous touch.

items.name: font-charis-sil
items.title: Charis SIL
items.description: The Charis project is intended to provide a free and open font family for all current languages and writing systems that use Latin and Cyrillic scripts.

items.name: font-charm
items.title: Charm
items.description: Charm is a handwritten Thai and Latin family. The letterforms were created using a flat tip pen on paper. It works well for Thai religous texts.

items.name: font-charmonman
items.title: Charmonman
items.description: Charmonman is a Thai and Latin family which takes inspiration from Zapfino. It features tall ascenders and descenders with swashed letterforms.

items.name: font-chathura
items.title: Chathura
items.description: Chathura was developed initially as an ASCII font in 2009 in the Ezi Fonts collection, which consists 42 Telugu ASCII fonts. In 2015 Chathura was developed into a Unicode font family with support for Telugu and Latin.

items.name: font-chau-philomene-one
items.title: Chau Philomene One
items.description: Chau Philomene One is one of four families within the Chau superfamily. Hardy, ideal for headings and highlighted text, with narrow letters and sharp angles that have a distinctive personality.

items.name: font-chela-one
items.title: Chela One
items.description: Chela One is a bold and condensed brush script typeface from Chilean type foundry LatinoType.

items.name: font-chelsea-market
items.title: Chelsea Market
items.description: Let's picnic on the High Line, grab some delights from the market and we'll people-watch from our cozy blanket nestled on a small patch of nature surrounded in the bustle of the city as it ages gracefully.

items.name: font-cherish
items.title: Cherish
items.description: Cherish is a gorgeous dry brush style that adds expression and sophistication to your design creations. Perfect for captions and short phrases combined with modern sans fonts.

items.name: font-cherry-bomb-one
items.title: Cherry Bomb One
items.description: Satsuyako first released the kana font CherryBomb in 2012 with the concept, "Cute with a kick." Its round and modern bounciness has made it appealing for diverse use from title logos and food packaging to children' s magazines.

items.name: font-cherry-cream-soda
items.title: Cherry Cream Soda
items.description: Cruise in to your favorite soda fountain and ask the jerk behind the counter to pull you a sweet red cherry cream soda! This extra wide sans-serif will take you back to the world of the 1950s teenager complete with bubbly enthusiasm and an...

items.name: font-cherry-swash
items.title: Cherry Swash
items.description: Cherry Swash is a contemporary slab-serif, with no stroke contrast yet eye-catching form with its elegant swash capitals. This typeface will look at its best in your headlines and logos.

items.name: font-chewy
items.title: Chewy
items.description: A font you can really sink your teeth into. And unlike all those tasteless fonts, Chewy never loses its flavor! Chewy is sealed for freshness in an easy-open package. Be sure to sample Squid's other main courses and side dishes!

items.name: font-chicle
items.title: Chicle
items.description: In a much needed break from complex scripts and polished packaging fonts, Koziupa and Paul decided to show their playful side. Chicle has bold, stretchable, kid-proof, pet-resistant letters.

items.name: font-chilanka
items.title: Chilanka
items.description: Chilanka is Malayalam handwriting style font designed by Santhosh Thottingal. It follows the common style one can see in everyday handwriting of Malayalam.

items.name: font-chivo
items.title: Chivo
items.description: Chivo ("Goat" in Spanish) is Omnibus-Type's first grotesque family. The strength of Chivo Black makes it ideal for highlights and headlines whilst Chivo Regular's elegance is ideal for continuous reading.

items.name: font-chivo-mono
items.title: Chivo Mono
items.description: Chivo (‘goat’ in Spanish) is the first Omnibus-Type neo-grotesque typeface family. Its solidness and balanced strokes give Chivo both elegance and practicality. Chivo Mono is the monospace sibling of Chivo.

items.name: font-chocolate-classical-sans
items.title: Chocolate Classical Sans
items.description: "Chocolate Classical Sans" is an open source font suitable for Traditional Chinese environments. This font uses inherited glyphs, largely adhering to the Inherited Glyphs standard maintained by the I.Font Project, combined with other...

items.name: font-chokokutai
items.title: Chokokutai
items.description: Chokokutai is a display Japanese font family whose characters have a funky appearance. To contribute to the project, visit github.com/go108go/Chokokutai

items.name: font-chonburi
items.title: Chonburi
items.description: Chonburi is a new Thai + Latin typeface for display usage, with an formal looped + serif design. The Chonburi project is led by Cadson Demak, a type foundry in Thailand. To contribute, see github.com/cadsondemak/chonburi

items.name: font-cinzel
items.title: Cinzel
items.description: Cinzel is a typeface inspired in first century roman inscriptions, and based on classical proportions. However it’s not a simple revivalism, while it conveys all the ancient history of the latin alphabet it also merges a contemporary feel...

items.name: font-cinzel-decorative
items.title: Cinzel Decorative
items.description: Cinzel is a typeface inspired in first century roman inscriptions, and based on classical proportions. However it’s not a simple revivalism, while it conveys all the ancient history of the latin alphabet it also merges a contemporary feel...

items.name: font-clarity-city
items.title: Clarity City

items.title: Encode Sans Expanded
items.description: Encode Sans is a versatile workhorse sans serif design, featuring a huge range of weights and widths, ready for all kind of typographic challenges.

items.description: Encode Sans is a versatile workhorse sans serif design, featuring a huge range of weights and widths, ready for all kind of typographic challenges.

items.title: Encode Sans Semi Expanded
items.description: Encode Sans is a versatile workhorse sans serif design, featuring a huge range of weights and widths, ready for all kind of typographic challenges.

items.name: font-engagement
items.title: Engagement
items.description: Semi-formal with a steady hand and soft contours, Engagement is a brush script that dances a line between vintage and modern flair.

items.name: font-englebert
items.title: Englebert
items.description: Englebert draws inspiration from the title screen of the 1930's film titled Der blue Engel, starring Marlene Dietrich. It is casual and playful in a mild manner, yet striking enough to catch the eye.

items.name: font-enriqueta
items.title: Enriqueta
items.description: Enriqueta is a serif typeface designed to meet the technical demands of silkscreen printing. Since that is a grid system, this makes it an excellent candidate for digital display applications too since they are built in pixels.

items.name: font-ephesis
items.title: Ephesis
items.description: Ephesis is a contemporary script great for casual invitations, cards, tubes, scrapbooking. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/ephesis.

items.name: font-epilogue
items.title: Epilogue
items.description: Epilogue is a sans serif variable font with a weight axis. 9 weights, upright and italic. It supports a wide range of languages in the latin script scope.

items.name: font-epunda-sans
items.title: Epunda Sans
items.description: Epunda Sans, a sans typeface by Typofactur.

items.name: font-epunda-slab
items.title: Epunda Slab
items.description: Epunda Slab, a serif typeface by Typofactur.

items.name: font-erica-one
items.title: Erica One
items.description: Erica is a voluptuous contemporary tribute to the sans serif work of Eric Gill that is mixed with the painter Botero.

items.name: font-esteban
items.title: Esteban
items.description: Esteban is a typeface intended to be used in texts, specially literature and poetry. Its a serif font with medium contrast, tall x height, medium compression, and robust serifs. It offers personality, readability and economy.

items.name: font-estedad
items.title: Estedad
items.description: Estedad, a sans typeface by Amin Abedi, Fontamin.

items.name: font-estonia
items.title: Estonia
items.description: Estonia is based on the calligraphic style found in the east European country of Estonia. The swash stylistic sets are designed to be used in conjunction with the regular version.

items.name: font-euphoria-script
items.title: Euphoria Script
items.description: Euphoria Script is an informal script type. It began with letterform sketches made by hand with a copperplate nib, which were redrawn digitally with the stroke endings of a brush script.

items.name: font-ewert
items.title: Ewert
items.description: Ewert is slab serif wood type inspired by and loosely based on the collection of cultural infographic maps by Estonian graphic artist Olev Soans.

items.name: font-exile
items.title: Exile
items.description: Exile, a display typeface by Bartłomiej Rózga.

items.name: font-exo
items.title: Exo
items.description: Exo is a contemporary geometric sans serif typeface that tries to convey a technological/futuristic feeling while keeping an elegant design.

items.name: font-exo-2
items.title: Exo 2
items.description: Exo 2 is a complete redrawing of Exo, a contemporary geometric sans serif typeface that tries to convey a technological/futuristic feeling while keeping an elegant design.

items.name: font-expletus-sans
items.title: Expletus Sans
items.description: Expletus Sans is a display typeface, which means that it is not recommended for long pieces of text. However, it's very effective for setting headers and other large sized text, due to it's way of pulling in the reader.

items.name: font-explora
items.title: Explora
items.description: Explora is a beautiful calligraphic typeface with swash forms. Its light and delicate strokes contribute to its elegance. In addition, it features one of the few fonts that contains the entire Cherokee Nation language glyphs.

items.name: font-faculty-glyphic
items.title: Faculty Glyphic
items.description: Faculty Glyphic, a sans typeface by Koto Studio.

items.name: font-fahkwang
items.title: Fahkwang
items.description: Fahkwang is a Thai and Latin san serif family which features a high contrast. It has been inspired by headlines in old Thai newspapers.

items.name: font-familjen-grotesk
items.title: Familjen Grotesk
items.description: Familjen Grotesk is a sans serif typeface with a contemporary appearance intended for both text and display. Large notches known as "ink traps" add style to headlines and clarity to small size text.

items.name: font-fanwood-text
items.title: Fanwood Text
items.description: Fanwood Text is a revival of Fairfield, the typeface first published in 1940 and designed by Rudolph Ruzicka, a famous Czech-American type designer.

items.name: font-farro
items.title: Farro
items.description: Farro is an artsy, four-weighted, display typeface that has a peculiar personality flowing through its European humanist silhouette. To contribute, see github.com/grayscaleltd/farro>.

items.name: font-farsan
items.title: Farsan
items.description: Farsan is a single-weight typeface that supports the Gujarati and Latin scripts. The Farsan project is led by Pooja Saxena, a type designer based in Bangalore, India. To contribute, see github.com/anexasajoop/farsan

items.name: font-fascinate
items.title: Fascinate
items.description: Fascinate and Fascinate Inline are nods to Art Deco yesteryear and typefaces like Broadway, yet they have an exaggerated x-height and softness that give them a friendly yet sophisticated vibe.

items.name: font-fascinate-inline
items.title: Fascinate Inline
items.description: Fascinate and Fascinate Inline are nods to Art Deco yesteryear and typefaces like Broadway, yet they have an exaggerated x-height and softness that give them a friendly yet sophisticated vibe.

items.name: font-faster-one
items.title: Faster One
items.description: Faster One was developed from a sans serif italics. In order to create an impression of velocity, the horizontal and gradual lines generate the idea of the image of the wind.

items.name: font-fasthand
items.title: Fasthand
items.description: Fasthand is a Khmer font for body text. The Khmer design is inspired by a popular style of Khmer handwriting letterforms that are written quickly. The Latin design is a copy of Seaweed Script, by Neapolitan.

items.name: font-fauna-one
items.title: Fauna One
items.description: Fauna is a modern typeface with low contrast strokes and soft terminals that form traditional serifs. Its structure is soft and slightly condensed. It reads clearly in paragraph composition and looks beautiful in headlines.

items.name: font-faustina
items.title: Faustina
items.description: Faustina is part of the Omnibus-Type Press Series, designed by Alfonso Garcia for editorial typography (books, newspapers and magazines) in print and online. In September 2019, the family has been converted into a variable font family.

items.name: font-federant
items.title: Federant
items.description: Federant revives the Reklameschrift typeface Feder Antiqua by Otto Ludwig Nägele (1911). The main challenge of designing a modern interpretation was to balance between applying visual corrections for overall consistency and staying close...

items.name: font-federo
items.title: Federo
items.description: Federo is a display webfont that references Jakob Erbar's Feder Grotesk. The goal was to keep the typeface as close as possible to the original 1909 design while adapting it for crisp web typography.

items.name: font-felipa
items.title: Felipa
items.description: Felipa is a carefully written calligraphic font based on a traditional Italian chancery cursive, though reinterpreted with a contemporary feeling.

items.name: font-fenix
items.title: Fenix
items.description: Fenix is a serif typeface designed for use in both display and long text. Very inspired by calligraphy, it has strong serifs and rough strokes. Its proportions are designed to gain space savings in text, both in height and width.

items.name: font-festive
items.title: Festive

items.name: font-figtree

items.description: Figtree, a sans typeface by Erik Kennedy.

items.name: font-finger-paint

items.description: Finger Paint began as an experiment with artistic brush effects and then became a real typeface. Learn more at carrois.com

items.description: Firjar, a sans typeface by Yazeed Omar.

items.name: font-fjalla-one
items.title: Fjalla One
items.description: Fjalla One is a medium contrast display sans serif. Fjalla One has been carefully adjusted to the restrictions of the screen. Despite having display characteristics Fjalla One can be used in a wide range of sizes.

items.name: font-flavors
items.title: Flavors
items.description: Does your blog taste bland? Is you website cooked up from the same old recipe? Ladies and gentlemen, we have the missing ingredient! With Flavors you'll get the zest and zing not found in those boring vanilla fonts.

items.name: font-fleur-de-leah
items.title: Fleur De Leah
items.description: Fleur De Leah is a formal script with a floral flavour. One of the first fonts to incorporate embellishment design elements within the letterforms.

items.name: font-flow-block

items.title: Foldit
items.description: Foldit is a variable-gradient COLRv1 font which uses gradients to play with dimensions and give a sense of space. The concept of this design was, as the name suggests, based on a folded paper strip.

items.name: font-fondamento
items.title: Fondamento
items.description: Fondamento and Fondamento Italic are calligraphic lettering styles based on the traditional Foundational Hand, a basic teaching style created by Edward Johnston in the early 20th century.

items.name: font-fontdiner-swanky
items.title: Fontdiner Swanky
items.description: Atomic Age science meets ultra cool with this swingin' retro latin sharp serif font we call Fontdiner Swanky! Like the older much hipper brother of it's Loungy counterpart, Swanky brings his bolder style and charming good looks when it's...

items.name: font-forum
items.title: Forum
items.description: Forum has antique, classic "Roman" proportions. It can be used to set body texts and works well in titles and headlines too.

items.name: font-fragment-mono

items.description: Fragment Mono is a monospaced coding version of Helvetica created by modifying and extending Nimbus Sans by URW Design Studio.

items.name: font-fragment-mono-sc

items.title: Francois One

items.name: font-frank-ruhl-libre
items.title: Frank Ruhl Libre
items.description: Frank Ruhl Libre is an open source version of the classic Hebrew typeface Frank Rühl, the most ubiquitous Hebrew typeface in print. Frank Rühl was designed in 1908 by Rafael Frank in collaboration with Auto Rühl of the C. F.

items.name: font-fraunces
items.title: Fraunces
items.description: Fraunces is a display, "Old Style" soft-serif typeface inspired by the mannerisms of early 20th century typefaces such as Windsor, Souvenir, and the Cooper Series.

items.name: font-freckle-face
items.title: Freckle Face
items.description: Freckle Face draws its inspiration from Pillbury's Funny Face drink mix packages. I loved these drink mixes when I was a kid, not only because of the great flavors, but also the fun packaging.

items.name: font-fredericka-the-great
items.title: Fredericka the Great
items.description: Fredericka recalls my college days of nights spent creating handdrawn presentation boards, architectural sketches and student union posters. She's fun, she's casual, she's preppy, she's classic, she's Great!

items.name: font-fredoka
items.title: Fredoka
items.description: Fredoka is a big, round, bold font that is perfect for adding a little fun to any headline or large text. The initial Latin component was designed by Milena Brandão. The later Hebrew component was designed by Ben Nathan.

items.name: font-freehand
items.title: Freehand
items.description: Freehand is a Khmer font for body text. The design is inspired by a popular style of Khmer handwriting letterforms. To contribute, see github.com/danhhong/Freehand.

items.name: font-freeman
items.title: Freeman
items.description: Freeman is a re-interpretation of the traditional display sans serif gothic typeface where some elements of the handwritten style are added to give a bit more personality to the design.

items.name: font-fresca
items.title: Fresca
items.description: A very friendly font for display use with a fresh atmosphere, Fresca gives the text an alternative to comic settings.

items.name: font-frijole
items.title: Frijole
items.description: What's on your font menu tonight? The same old boring beans? Then why not try Frijole! Its a fresh new face that's anything but re-fried.

items.name: font-fruktur
items.title: Fruktur
items.description: Fruktur initially appears to be a playful and powerful black letter type with a warm friendly feeling. However its construction is closer to that of an upright italic.

items.name: font-fugaz-one
items.title: Fugaz One
items.description: Fugaz One is a sans serif with very geometric features and gestural characteristics, which brings it away from its formal beginnings. Combined with its italic inclination, Fugaz One has become a very dynamic font.

items.name: font-fuggles
items.title: Fuggles
items.description: Take a little Inspiration, mix in some Sassy Frass and a splash of Waterfall; add hundreds of alternate forms and you have the recipe for a versatile handwriting font. This fun, scribbly little font can fool you.

items.name: font-funnel-display
items.title: Funnel Display
items.description: Funnel Display, a display typeface by NORD ID, Kristian Möller.

items.name: font-funnel-sans

items.name: font-fuzzy-bubbles
items.title: Fuzzy Bubbles

items.name: font-ga-maamli
items.title: Ga Maamli

items.name: font-gabarito
items.title: Gabarito

items.name: font-gabriela
items.title: Gabriela
items.description: Gabriela is a Latin and Cyrillic serif typeface with soft shapes, and special terminal forms which are shaped like curls. They connect each letter to create attractive word shapes and text blocks with a fine texture.

items.name: font-gaegu
items.title: Gaegu
items.description: Gaegu is a Korean and Latin font

items.name: font-gafata
items.title: Gafata
items.description: Gafata is a font designed for small sizes in medium-long text, mixing elegance and readability which is why it has great applicability in books, magazines and web pages.

items.name: font-gajraj-one
items.title: Gajraj One
items.description: Gajraj (the king of elephants) is a Latin display typeface with Devanagari language support, designed for use in large hoardings, signage, and print materials for branding and advertising.

items.name: font-galada
items.title: Galada
items.description: Galada is a Bengali and Latin font that started with the famous Latin Lobster font, and extended the design to Bengali. The Bengali was developed as a studio collaboration by Jeremie Hornus, Yoann Minet, and Juan Bruce.

items.name: font-galdeano
items.title: Galdeano
items.description: Galdeano is a humanist san serif typeface with strong variation in its stroke weight. The general form is slightly condensed. It has soft variation in its contrast, diagonal stress and open forms to improve legibility.

items.name: font-galindo
items.title: Galindo
items.description: The Galindo typeface is an inspired spin off light-hearted animated fonts with geometric counters.

items.name: font-gamja-flower
items.title: Gamja Flower
items.description: Gamja Flower is a Korean and Latin font.

items.name: font-gantari
items.title: Gantari
items.description: Gantari is a sans serif font with a geometric touch, designed by Anugrah Pasau from Lafontype. Gantari is not purely geometric, proportions have been designed so that all characters can look harmonious.

items.name: font-gasoek-one
items.title: Gasoek One
items.description: When people mention "Soek" in South Korea, they will think of the Chinese character. This word gives the impression of being as thick and hard as a stone. Ga means "to add" in Korean.

items.name: font-gayathri
items.title: Gayathri
items.description: A gentle and modern Malayalam display typeface. Available in three weights, Gayathri is best suited for headlines, posters, titles and captions. Unicode compliant and libre licensed. To contribute, see gitlab.com/smc/fonts/gayathri.

items.name: font-geist
items.title: Geist

items.name: font-geist-mono

items.description: Geist Pixel, a display typeface by Andrés Briganti, Evil Rabbit, Guillermo Rauch.

items.name: font-gloock
items.title: Gloock
items.description: Gloock is a contemporary high-contrast serif typeface intended for display use. It draws inspiration from newspaper's headlines but with a contemporary approach. Its main focus is the smooth relationship between the thin and thick strokes.

items.name: font-gloria-hallelujah
