items.description: This font is based on the handwriting of a Korean high school student. It is fun and reminds me of a comic style writing. It looks great in all caps and is easy to read.

items.name: font-glory
items.title: Glory
items.description: Glory is a modern sans serif font. The rounded corners give it a soft, contemporary feel. While the characters are slightly condensed, this medium contrast sans features subtly curved vertical strokes.

items.name: font-gluten
items.title: Gluten
items.description: Gluten is a delicious font! It's also slightly loud, very round, and 100% fun. Gluten is filling, we'll put it that way. Hope you're hungry. To contribute see github.com/Etcetera-Type-Co/Gluten.

items.name: font-goblin-one
items.title: Goblin One
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Goblin One belongs to the category of display types called "Latin". This is because of its sharp triangular serifs. Goblin One was inspired by a hand painted sign above a pub in the town of Reading (UK).

items.name: font-gochi-hand
items.title: Gochi Hand
items.description: Gochi Hand is a typographic interpretation of the handwriting of a teenager. The style is fresh, not like the letters made by a calligrapher, but those of an ordinary person.

items.name: font-goldman
items.title: Goldman
items.description: Goldman is a Latin display typeface designed by Jaikishan Patel. It was exclusively designed for posters of Genre: Passion, Science Fiction, Sports, Drama, Thriller genres. The Goldman font family includes two weights.

items.name: font-golos-text
items.title: Golos Text
items.description: Golos is a versatile closed sans-serif commissioned by Smena and AIC Media for state and social service websites. Golos Text suits perfectly for continuous reading on screen. It includes five weights from Regular to Black.

items.name: font-google-sans
items.title: Google Sans
items.description: Google Sans, a sans typeface by Google.

items.name: font-google-sans-code
items.title: Google Sans Code
items.description: Google Sans Code, a mono typeface by Google, Universal Thirst.

items.name: font-google-sans-flex
items.title: Google Sans Flex
items.description: Google Sans Flex, a sans typeface by Google.

items.name: font-gorditas
items.title: Gorditas
items.description: Gorditas is a fun and funky display slab serif typeface family, with heart details - cute like a newborn puppy! Designed by Brenda Gallo and Gustavo Dipre.

items.name: font-gothic-a1
items.title: Gothic A1
items.description: Gothic A1 is a Korean and Latin font.

items.name: font-gotu
items.title: Gotu
items.description: Rotund curves, large loops and voluminous counters. Gotu reimagines Devanagari calligraphy while at the same time reinterprets what high contrast Latin typefaces can be.

items.name: font-goudy-bookletter-1911
items.title: Goudy Bookletter 1911
items.description: Based on Frederic Goudy’s Kennerley Oldstyle. A few words on why I think Kennerley Oldstyle is beautiful: In making this font, I discovered that Kennerley fits together tightly and evenly with almost no kerning.

items.name: font-gowun-batang
items.title: Gowun Batang
items.description: Gowun Batang(고운바탕) is a serif text typeface inspired by neat, pencil-written handwriting letterforms. Gowun means ‘neat and delicate’ in Korean and this typeface has a warm and friendly impression.

items.name: font-gowun-dodum
items.title: Gowun Dodum
items.description: Gowun Dodum(고운돋움) is a humanist sans-serif typeface with a touch of hand movement. Gowun means ‘neat and delicate’ in Korean and this typeface has a warm and friendly impression.

items.name: font-graduate
items.title: Graduate
items.description: "Graduate" showcases a high-quality rendition of the classic college block style of lettering commonly seen across campuses throughout the USA. To contribute, visit github.com/etunni/graduate.

items.name: font-grand-hotel
items.title: Grand Hotel
items.description: Grand Hotel finds its inspiration from the title screen of the 1937 film "Cafe Metropole" starring Tyrone Power. This condensed upright connecting script has a classic vibe to it.

items.name: font-grandiflora-one
items.title: Grandiflora One
items.description: Grandiflora, or in its original language, Neungsohwa is a decorative Hangeul typeface inspired by the Art Nouveau style of the 20th century.

items.name: font-grandstander
items.title: Grandstander
items.description: Grandstander is a display variable font with a weight axis. 9 weights, upright and italic. It supports a wide range of languages in the latin script scope.

items.name: font-grape-nuts
items.title: Grape Nuts
items.description: Grape Nuts is a simple handwritten casual font. The name is derived from a well-known breakfast cereal that dates back to the late 1800s. This cute style can be used for any casual or even humorous situation.

items.name: font-gravitas-one
items.title: Gravitas One
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Gravitas One is modeled on the "UK fat face" which is a kind of very heavy advertising type created during the industrial revolution in England.

items.name: font-great-vibes
items.title: Great Vibes
items.description: Great Vibes is a beautifully flowing script with casual uppercase forms combined with more formal lowercase letters. It has over 2000 glyphs, with smooth connecting ligatures and alternate characters.

items.name: font-grechen-fuemen
items.title: Grechen Fuemen
items.description: Grechen Fuemen is a playful font with an unorthodox use of thick and thin weights. Don't take this font too seriously because there's not a serious stroke in the font.

items.name: font-grenze
items.title: Grenze
items.description: Grenze is a large text family which features nine weights with matching italics. It draws inspiration from Roman and Blackletter typefaces. It was originally designed to be used in magazines.

items.name: font-grenze-gotisch
items.title: Grenze Gotisch
items.description: Grenze Gotisch is a Blackletter version of Grenze, which has more dramatic details in certain letters. To contribute, see github.com/Omnibus-Type/Grenze-Gotisch.

items.name: font-grey-qo
items.title: Grey Qo
items.description: A contemporary calligraphic script, Grey Qo combines traditional uppercase calligraphics with more stylized script lowercase forms. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support.

items.name: font-griffy
items.title: Griffy
items.description: He's one cool customer with that crazy casual beatnik outfit, a long silky goatee and a touch of spooky just to give you the creeps... They call him Griffy!

items.name: font-gruppo
items.title: Gruppo
items.description: Gruppo was conceived as a display typeface for style conscious, laid-back branding where 'little is more', or, in Jasper Morrison's words, "Special is generally less useful than normal".

items.name: font-gudea
items.title: Gudea
items.description: Gudea is a readable, clear and functional typeface family, with a simple and condensed structure that brings a pleasant feeling when used at any size.

items.name: font-gugi
items.title: Gugi
items.description: Gugi is a Korean and Latin font.

items.name: font-gulim
items.title: Gulim
items.description: Gulim is a well-known gothic-style font that first shipped with Windows 95. It was designed with clean, simple strokes for clarity in user interfaces, and has rounded terminals. This version includes proportional Latin characters.

items.name: font-gulimche
items.title: GulimChe
items.description: GulimChe is a well-known gothic-style font that first shipped with Windows 95. It was designed with clean, simple strokes for clarity in user interfaces, and has rounded terminals.

items.name: font-gulzar
items.title: Gulzar
items.description: Gulzar is a contemporary Urdu Nasta’liq typeface – and its Latin counterpart – designed and developed through a collaboration by Borna Izadpanah (Principal Designer and Project Leader), Simon Cozens (Font Engineering), Alice Savoie...

items.name: font-gungsuh
items.title: Gungsuh
items.description: Gungsuh is a well-known myeongjo(brush)-style font that first shipped with Windows 95. It is derived from handwritten calligraphy and is more suitable for shorter text strings or display applications than long-form text.

items.name: font-gungsuhche
items.title: GungsuhChe
items.description: GungsuhChe is a well-known myeongjo(brush)-style font that first shipped with Windows 95. It is derived from handwritten calligraphy and is more suitable for shorter text strings or display applications than long-form text.

items.name: font-gupter
items.title: Gupter
items.description: Gupter is a condensed serif font inspired by early 20th century English fonts such as Times New Roman. The family excels in small spaces due to its large x-height and condensed letterforms.

items.name: font-gurajada
items.title: Gurajada
items.description: Gurajada is Telugu handwriting font, suitable for headings, posters, and invitations. The Telugu is designed and developed by Purushoth Kumar Guttula in 2013 and made available by Silicon Andhra under the SIL Open Font License v1.1.

items.name: font-gveret-levin
items.title: Gveret Levin
items.description: Gveret Levin, a handwritten typeface by AlefAlefAlef.

items.name: font-gwendolyn
items.title: Gwendolyn
items.description: This is a charming semi-formal script style. Need an enchanting look to go with a fantasy-like bedtime story? Gwendolyn will work beautifully. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support.

items.name: font-habibi
items.title: Habibi
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Habibi is a high contrast serifed text face. Habibi is easy to read and offers a certain elegance to go with this.

items.name: font-hachi-maru-pop
items.title: Hachi Maru Pop
items.description: HachiMaruPop is a cute font that was popular among young Japanese girls in the 1970s and 1980s. It has an informal handwritten appearance which works well at larger sizes.

items.name: font-hahmlet
items.title: Hahmlet
items.description: Hahmlet is inspired by a poster for the Korean ‘Hamlet’ movie from the 1940’s, created by an unknown letterer. The distinct and sharp, quirky and attention seeking details inspired Minjoo Ham to use it for a rather uncommon revival project...

items.name: font-halant
items.title: Halant
items.description: Halant is a typeface family supporting the Devanagari and Latin scripts. This is an Open Source font family, first published by the Indian Type Foundry in 2014.

items.name: font-hammersmith-one
items.title: Hammersmith One
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Hammersmith One is a very low contrast typeface inspired by the Johnston UK lettering tradition. Hammersmith One shows the quirks of a somewhat naive, handmade, brush written letters including a wider than normal...

items.name: font-hanalei
items.title: Hanalei
items.description: Hanalei is for the Polynesian fan. Inspired by the bamboo lettering of the iconic Mai Kai restaurant logo, Hanalei has all the flavor of the genre without compromise. Great for titling and larger typesetting.

items.name: font-hanalei-fill
items.title: Hanalei Fill
items.description: Hanalei Fill is for the Polynesian fan. Inspired by the bamboo lettering of the iconic Mai Kai restaurant logo, Hanalei Fill has all the flavor of the genre without compromise. Great for titling and larger typesetting.

items.name: font-handjet
items.title: Handjet
items.description: Handjet is an element-based variable font (aka pixel font, modular font, …) where every glyph is composed using multiple copies of the same element.

items.name: font-handlee
items.title: Handlee
items.description: Handlee is loosely based on the handwriting of typographer Joe Prince. Its inconsistent curves give it a nice, human-like quality that is reflected in the characters.

items.name: font-hanken-grotesk
items.title: Hanken Grotesk
items.description: Hanken Grotesk is a sans serif typeface inspired by the classic grotesques. Geometry, metrics, punctuations and OpenType features have been updated to support a wide range of projects such as environmental signage, textface for books and...

items.name: font-hanuman
items.title: Hanuman
items.description: Hanuman is a Khmer font for body text, that pairs well with Latin serif fonts. To contribute, see github.com/danhhong/Hanuman.

items.name: font-happy-monkey
items.title: Happy Monkey
items.description: Happy Monkey is a display sans serif typeface family, with thin and rounded strokes. Suitable for informal headlines and all your fun typography! Designed by Brenda Gallo and Gustavo Dipre.

items.name: font-harmattan
items.title: Harmattan
items.description: Harmattan, named after the trade winds that blow during the winter in West Africa, is designed in a Warsh style to suit the needs of languages using the Arabic script in West Africa.

items.name: font-headland-one
items.title: Headland One
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Headland One is a text typeface designed to be highly legible and comfortable when reading screens. Headland One is useful from very small sizes to headlines.

items.name: font-hedvig-letters-sans
items.title: Hedvig Letters Sans
items.description: Hedvig is a digital insurance company that is challenging the traditional insurance industry by providing a predictable insurance experience.

items.name: font-hedvig-letters-serif
items.title: Hedvig Letters Serif
items.description: Hedvig Letters Serif, a serif typeface by Kanon Foundry, Alexander Örn, Tor Weibull, Hedvig.

items.name: font-heebo
items.title: Heebo
items.description: Heebo is a Hebrew and Latin typeface family, which extends Christian Roberton's Roboto Latin to Hebrew. The Hebrew was drawn by Oded Ezer and the font files were mastered by Meir Sadan.

items.name: font-henny-penny
items.title: Henny Penny
items.description: Henny Penny is an offbeat display font with loads of personality, named in honour of the fairy-tale character chicken Henny Penny. It is a friendly and playful decorative typeface.

items.name: font-hepta-slab
items.title: Hepta Slab
items.description: Hepta Slab is a slab-serif revival based on specimens of antique genre types from Bruce and Co., primarily Antique 307. The family is a variable font which consists of 10 weights with the extremes intended for display use and the middle...

items.name: font-hermeneus-one
items.title: Hermeneus One
items.description: Hermeneus is a grecian style font, inspired by the works of Jim Parkinson and Ortiz Lopez. It condensation lets you put more characters into a line of text giving your paragraphs more efficiency.

items.name: font-herr-von-muellerhoff
items.title: Herr Von Muellerhoff
items.description: The Charles Bluemlein Script Collection is an intriguing reminder of the heady days of hand lettering and calligraphy in the United States.

items.name: font-hi-melody
items.title: Hi Melody
items.description: Hi Melody is a Korean and Latin font.

items.name: font-hibur-mono
items.title: Hibur Mono
items.description: Hibur Mono, a mono typeface by TypeHabesha, Behailu Berento.

items.name: font-hina-mincho
items.title: Hina Mincho
items.description: Hina Mincho is old-fashined and cute Japanese font. It includes Google Latin Plus, hiragana, katakana, JIS level 1 and 2 kanji glyphs. This font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.

items.name: font-hind
items.title: Hind
items.description: Hind is an Open Source typeface supporting the Devanagari and Latin scripts. Developed explicitly for use in User Interface design, the Hind font family includes five styles.

items.name: font-hind-colombo
items.title: Hind Colombo
items.description: Hind Colombo is a family of five Sinhala fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project.

items.name: font-hind-guntur
items.title: Hind Guntur
items.description: Hind Guntur is a family of five Telugu fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project. In addition to Telugu, the Hind Guntur fonts also include Latin-script characters.

items.name: font-hind-jalandhar
items.title: Hind Jalandhar
items.description: Hind Jalandhar is a family of five Gurmukhi fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project.

items.name: font-hind-kochi
items.title: Hind Kochi
items.description: Hind Kochi is a family of five Malayalam fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project.

items.name: font-hind-madurai
items.title: Hind Madurai
items.description: Hind Madurai is a family of five Tamil fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project. In addition to Tamil, the Hind Madurai fonts also include Latin-script characters.

items.name: font-hind-mysuru
items.title: Hind Mysuru
items.description: Hind Mysuru is a family of five Kannada fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project.

items.name: font-hind-siliguri
items.title: Hind Siliguri
items.description: Hind Siliguri is a family of five Bengali fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project.

items.name: font-hind-vadodara
items.title: Hind Vadodara
items.description: Hind Vadodara is a family of five Gujarati fonts, which are part of the Indian Type Foundry’s larger Open Source Hind Multi-Script project.

items.name: font-holtwood-one-sc
items.title: Holtwood One SC
items.description: Holtwood is a bold display font developed for use with modern web browsers. It has a lot of the look of some traditional woodblock poster typefaces of the Nineteenth Century but updated for the Twenty First.

items.name: font-homemade-apple
items.title: Homemade Apple
items.description: Nothing says down-home goodness like a delicious Homemade Apple pie. For a good one, you have to make it yourself. Should you find yourself lacking in the recipe department, use this beautifully drawn cursive handwriting script font to...

items.name: font-homenaje
items.title: Homenaje
items.description: Homenaje is inspired by the bronze cemetery art found in the Recoleta and Chacaritas districts of Buenos Aires, Argentina.

items.name: font-honk
items.title: Honk
items.description: Loud, bright, and exuberantly fun! Honk is a variable colour font from Ek Type. It is a riotous digital interpretation of the bold and boisterous lettering seen on Indian trucks.

items.name: font-host-grotesk
items.title: Host Grotesk
items.description: Host Grotesk, a sans typeface by Element Type, Doğukan Karapınar, İbrahim Kaçtıoğlu.

items.name: font-hubballi
items.title: Hubballi
items.description: Hubballi is a Kannada and Latin typeface designed by Erin McLaughlin. Hubballi is a monolinear typeface with an informal, friendly appearance. To contribute to the project, visit github.com/erinmclaughlin/Hubballi

items.name: font-hubot-sans
items.title: Hubot Sans
items.description: Hubot Sans, a sans typeface by Tobias Bjerrome Ahlin, GitHub, Degarism Studio, Sebastian Carewe.

items.name: font-huninn
items.title: Huninn
items.description: Huninn, a sans typeface by justfont.

items.name: font-hurricane
items.title: Hurricane
items.description: A storm has been brewing. It’s Hurricane. Flair and excitement abounds with this fast moving spirited brush script. There are three regular styles incorporated into the PRO version of the this font, plus graphics to add an extra breeze to...

items.name: font-iansui
items.title: Iansui
items.description: Iansui, a handwritten typeface by But Ko.

items.name: font-ibarra-real-nova
items.title: Ibarra Real Nova
items.description: In 2007, The Calcografía Nacional Española organized a project directed by José María Ribagorda with the objective of divulging the invaluable typographic heritage produced in Spain in the 18th century through the "Imprenta Real".

items.name: font-ibm-plex-mono
items.title: IBM Plex Mono
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.name: font-ibm-plex-sans
items.title: IBM Plex Sans
items.description: IBM Plex™ is an international typeface family designed by Mike Abbink, IBM BX&D, in collaboration with Bold Monday, an independent Dutch type foundry.

items.title: IBM Plex Sans Arabic
items.description: IBM Plex™ is an international typeface family designed by Mike Abbink, IBM BX&D, in collaboration with Bold Monday, an independent Dutch type foundry.

items.title: IBM Plex Sans Condensed
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.title: IBM Plex Sans Devanagari
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.title: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.title: IBM Plex Sans JP
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.title: IBM Plex Sans KR
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.title: IBM Plex Sans Thai
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.title: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.name: font-ibm-plex-serif
items.title: IBM Plex Serif
items.description: IBM Plex® is the corporate typeface for IBM worldwide and an open-source project developed by the IBM Brand & Experience team (BX&D).

items.name: font-iceberg
items.title: Iceberg
items.description: Iceberg is a slim condensed decorative webfont by Victor Kharyk suitable for medium to large sizes. It is monolinear and mostly monospaced, has long ascenders and descenders, and a modular construction that builds a rhythm.

items.name: font-iceland
items.title: Iceland
items.description: The idea of geometric typefaces with a look reminiscent of the machinery, technology, and interior design of the 1950s originated in Eurostile family by Aldo Novarese and Alessandro Butti (1952).

items.name: font-idiqlat

items.description: Idiqlat, a serif typeface by SIL International.

items.name: font-imbue
items.title: Imbue
items.description: Imbue is a variable condensed didone made for your special occasion. The result is something crisp and curvy with two variable axes: weight and optical size. Imbue was designed by Tyler Finck.

items.name: font-imperial-script
items.title: Imperial Script
items.description: Imperial Script is a formal script font with clean connections and an elegant look. The thin connectors combined with the heavier shade strokes makes Imperial perfect for invitations, formal events and seasonal settings.

items.name: font-imprima
items.title: Imprima
items.description: Imprima looks excellent even on cheap home printers because it has broad counters, strong joins between stems and inktraps that enable it to perform well in very small sizes.

items.name: font-inclusive-sans
items.title: Inclusive Sans
items.description: Inclusive Sans is a text font designed for accessibility and readability. It is inspired by the friendly personality of contemporary neo-grotesques while incorporating key features to make it highly legible in all uses.

items.name: font-inconsolata
items.title: Inconsolata
items.description: Inconsolata was Raph Levien's first serious original font release. It is a monospace font, designed for printed code listings and the like.

items.name: font-inder
items.title: Inder
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Inder is a low contrast workhorse sans serif text face design. It was inspired by German art noveau style lettering and the Amsterdam School of architecture.

items.name: font-indie-flower
items.title: Indie Flower
items.description: This handwriting font feels carefree and open to me with the bubbly, rounded edges. It is easy to read and a bit bolder than some of my other fonts.

items.name: font-ingrid-darling
items.title: Ingrid Darling
items.description: Ingrid Darling is a cute script font originally created for greeting cards. It is based on a cursive hand writing style that has a playful, whimsical appeal.

items.name: font-inika
items.title: Inika
items.description: Inspired by Easter Island and its Rapa Nui language and culture, this typeface captures the essence of an island located in Chile, South America, full of mystery, sacred places and stories of the past.

items.name: font-inknut-antiqua
items.title: Inknut Antiqua
items.description: »Inknut Antiqua« is an Antiqua typeface for literature and long-form text. Approaching the idea of web-publishing as a modern day private press, it is designed to evoke Venetian incunabula and humanist manuscripts, but with the quirks and...

items.name: font-inria-sans
items.title: Inria Sans
items.description: Inria Sans and Inria Serif are the two members of a type family design for the communication of Inria, a national institute dedicated to numeric research.

items.name: font-inria-serif
items.title: Inria Serif
items.description: Inria Sans and Inria Serif are the two members of a type family design for the communication of Inria, a national institute dedicated to numeric research.

items.name: font-inspiration
items.title: Inspiration
items.description: Have a party with Inspiration. A fun, script font with a less-than-serious bounce. You may have seen the use of Inspiration in the logo for Michaels craft stores.

items.name: font-instrument-sans
items.title: Instrument Sans
items.description: Instrument Sans is a font designed for the Instrument brand. It's a variable sans-serif which balances an abundance of precision with subtle notes of playfulness. Inspiration was drawn from our enduring interest in neo-grotesques.

items.name: font-instrument-serif
items.title: Instrument Serif
items.description: Instrument Serif is a condensed display font designed for the Instrument brand. It is intended for use at large sizes and offers a contemporary take on some of the time-tested characteristics found in old-style serifs.

items.name: font-intel-one-mono
items.title: Intel One Mono
items.description: Intel One Mono, a mono typeface by Intel Corporation, Frere-Jones Type.

items.name: font-inter
items.title: Inter
items.description: Inter is a variable font family carefully crafted & designed for computer screens. Inter features a tall x-height to aid in readability of mixed-case and lower-case text.

items.name: font-inter-tight
items.title: Inter Tight
items.description: This is a specialized version of Inter with tighter spacing, for display usage. This version also has Roman and Italic styles. To contribute, see github.com/rsms/inter-gf-tight.

items.name: font-iosevka-charon
items.title: Iosevka Charon
items.description: Iosevka Charon, a mono typeface by Juliette Pluto.

items.name: font-iosevka-charon-mono
items.title: Iosevka Charon Mono
items.description: Iosevka Charon Mono, a mono typeface by Juliette Pluto.

items.name: font-irish-grover
items.title: Irish Grover
items.description: Presenting Irish Grover! No, it's not a coveted new AKC breed. No, it's not a tasty seasonal pilsner. It's a fun, flamboyant, new display font by Squid that's way better than any of those possibilities. Sure and it's free for Pete's sake!

items.name: font-island-moments
items.title: Island Moments
items.description: Take a trip to a tropical paradise. This brush style font has an exotic appeal with alternate uppercase characters borrowed from the font, Babylonica. This OpenType Pro version offers extra alternate characters.

items.name: font-isometra
items.title: Isometra
items.description: Isometra, a serif typeface by Ben Dunkle.

items.name: font-istok-web
items.title: Istok Web
items.description: Istok Web is an original typeface, in development since 2008. At first some basic letters were based on specially modified METAFONT sources from the CM Bright font family from the TeX community.

items.name: font-italiana
items.title: Italiana
items.description: Italiana was designed for use in the headlines of newspapers and magazines. Italiana is inspired by the calligraphy of the Italian masters. It is suitable for design solutions that require elegance and sophistication.

items.name: font-italianno
items.title: Italianno
items.description: Italianno is an elegant, calligraphic script. It's clean connecting strokes distinguish itself from other classic forms which makes it perfect for invitations, scrap-booking, and packaging.

items.name: font-itim
items.title: Itim
items.description: Itim is a new Thai + Latin handwriting typeface, with an informal looped + semiserif design. It has 2 stylistic set alternate glyph designs and intelligent OpenType features to recreate the impression of handwriting.

items.name: font-jacquard-12
items.title: Jacquard 12
items.description: Jacquard is an expanded revival typeface from a Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa 1880. The Soft Type is a collection of typefaces designed for knitting color-work.

items.name: font-jacquard-12-charted
items.title: Jacquard 12 Charted
items.description: Jacquard is an expanded revival typeface from a Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa 1880. Designing typefaces for knitting is essentially the same as creating pixel types.

items.name: font-jacquard-24
items.title: Jacquard 24
items.description: Jacquard is an expanded revival typeface from a Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa 1880. Designing typefaces for knitting is essentially the same as creating pixel types.

items.name: font-jacquard-24-charted
items.title: Jacquard 24 Charted
items.description: Jacquard is an expanded revival typeface from a Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa 1880. Designing typefaces for knitting is essentially the same as creating pixel types.

items.name: font-jacquarda-bastarda-9
items.title: Jacquarda Bastarda 9
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jacquarda Bastarda is an expanded revival typeface from a bastarda-esque Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa...

items.name: font-jacquarda-bastarda-9-charted
items.title: Jacquarda Bastarda 9 Charted
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jacquarda Bastarda is an expanded revival typeface from a bastarda-esque Victorian needlepoint alphabet designed in Berlin by Heinrich Kuehn circa...

items.name: font-jacques-francois
items.title: Jacques Francois
items.description: Jacques Francois revives the c. 1760 Enschedé no. 811 type specimen by Jacques François Rosart (1714-1774), made for Enschedé Printing House.

items.name: font-jacques-francois-shadow
items.title: Jacques Francois Shadow
items.description: Jacques Francois Shadow is an incised variant of the Jacques Francois font. Jacques Francois revives the c. 1760 Enschedé no. 811 type specimen by Jacques François Rosart (1714-1774), made for Enschedé Printing House.

items.name: font-jaini
items.title: Jaini
items.description: Jaini and Jaini Purva (both Devanagari) are typefaces based on the calligraphic style of the Jain Kalpasutra manuscripts, particularly referencing a manuscript from 1503 CE.

items.name: font-jaini-purva
items.title: Jaini Purva
items.description: Jaini Purva and Jaini (both Devanagari) are typefaces based on the calligraphic style of the Jain Kalpasutra manuscripts, particularly referencing a manuscript from 1503 CE.

items.name: font-jaldi
items.title: Jaldi
items.description: Jaldi is the Hindi word for soon, and the typeface family is a contemporary sans-serif Devanagari with subtle rounded corners.

items.name: font-jaro
items.title: Jaro
items.description: Jaro, a sans typeface by Agyei Archer, Céline Hurka, Mirko Velimirović.

items.name: font-jersey-10
items.title: Jersey 10
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-10-charted
items.title: Jersey 10 Charted
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-15
items.title: Jersey 15
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-15-charted
items.title: Jersey 15 Charted
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-20
items.title: Jersey 20
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-20-charted
items.title: Jersey 20 Charted
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-25
items.title: Jersey 25
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versitile sans-serif typeface, knittable at various sizes.

items.name: font-jersey-25-charted
items.title: Jersey 25 Charted
items.description: The Soft Type Collection is designed for knitters to chart out their typographic projects. Jersey is a sporty, versatile sans-serif typeface, knittable in various sizes.

items.name: font-jetbrains-mono
items.title: JetBrains Mono
items.description: JetBrains Mono is a typeface made for the specific needs of developers. Find more informations about font features, design and language support on www.jetbrains.com/. JetBrains Mono is designed by Philipp Nurullin and Konstantin Bulenkov.

items.name: font-jim-nightshade
items.title: Jim Nightshade
items.description: Certain calligraphic pen styles have always had a mysterious and almost dark vibe to them from my viewpoint. Jim Nightshade is one of those styles.

items.name: font-joan
items.title: Joan
items.description: Inspired by the roman cut by Francesco Griffo, it is a tribute to the Italian style, a model to follow even in the 15th century. Joan is characterized by neat serifs as well as sharp terminals and is intended for books and magazines.

items.name: font-jockey-one
items.title: Jockey One
items.description: Jockey One is a new sans serif, designed by TypeTogether - Veronika Burian and José Scaglione.

items.name: font-jolly-lodger
items.title: Jolly Lodger
items.description: Wherever your travels may take you, you'll always find a confortable host off the interstate at the Jolly Lodger! Air conditioning, cable television and the freshest assortment of baked goods delivered fresh to your room each morning!

items.name: font-jomhuria
items.title: Jomhuria
items.description: Jomhuria is a dark Persian/Arabic and Latin display typeface, suitable for headline and other display usage. The name means 'republic,' and the spark of inspiration for the design was a stencil of “Shablon” showing just a limited character...

items.name: font-jomolhari
items.title: Jomolhari
items.description: Jomolhari is a free, Unicode compatible, Tibetan script font named after Mt Jomolhari on the border of Bhutan and Tibet. This font can be used for Tibetan and Dzongkha text.

items.name: font-josefin-sans
items.title: Josefin Sans
items.description: The idea of this typeface is to be geometric, elegant, with a vintage feeling, for use at larger sizes. It is inspired by geometric sans serif designs from the 1920s.

items.name: font-josefin-slab
items.title: Josefin Slab
items.description: Josefin Slab was the first typeface–at least in my mind–I designed! But I decided to start simple with Josefin Sans. Following the 1930s trend for geometric typefaces, it just came to me that something between Kabel and Memphis with modern...

items.name: font-jost
items.title: Jost
items.description: Jost is an original font created by indestructible type*. It is inspired by 1920s German sans-serifs. This is version 3.7. Jost is designed and maintained by Owen Earl, who is the creator of the font foundry indestructible type*.

items.name: font-joti-one
items.title: Joti One
items.description: I enjoyed designing this typeface because it was inspired by my little son "Jonah," who is called by his friends "Joti." The type has the informality and style of the cartoons which children watch.

items.name: font-jua
items.title: Jua
items.description: Jua is a Korean and Latin font

items.name: font-judson
items.title: Judson
items.description: Judson is a serif font designed for African literacy. It contains as many glyphs and precomposed combinations that I know of for all African languages written in Latin-derived alphabets.

items.name: font-julee
items.title: Julee
items.description: The peculiarity of this typography lies in its curved structures and strokes, which are developed on it by getting thinner and sharper as if they were being typed using a metallic and bevel-edged point.

items.name: font-julius-sans-one
items.title: Julius Sans One
items.description: Julius Sans One is a sans serif typeface family from Chilean type foundry LatinoType. Updated, April 2015: hinting was applied (with ttfautohint) and the non-breaking space glyph was adjusted to be the same width as space.

items.name: font-junge
items.title: Junge
items.description: Junge is an elegant and slim text typeface inspired by the calligraphy of Günther Junge. Thanks to a combination of features it performs equally well in most ranges. At small sizes it builds the impression of flittering strokes.

items.name: font-jura
items.title: Jura
items.description: Jura is a family of sans-serif fonts in the Eurostile vein. It was originally inspired by some work I was doing for the FreeFont project in designing a Kayah Li range for FreeMono.

items.name: font-just-another-hand
items.title: Just Another Hand
items.description: My personal handwriting has changed a number of times over the years. Just Another Hand is a narrow brush drawn handwriting font, inspired by the handwriting of my high school days.

items.name: font-just-me-again-down-here
items.title: Just Me Again Down Here
items.description: Just Me Again Down Here was created a few weeks after my family and I moved to China, using a Wacom Tablet and Adobe Illustrator. This is my “messy” handwriting with mixed capitals and irregularities.

items.name: font-k2d
items.title: K2D
items.description: K2D is a Thai and Latin family which has a modern appearance but features Thai's traditional looped letterforms.

items.name: font-kablammo
items.title: Kablammo
items.description: Kablammo is an experimental variable font, taking inspiration from maximalist curly doodad designs from the ’90s, the Memphis Design movement, as well as cartoons and toys from those eras.

items.name: font-kadwa
items.title: Kadwa
items.description: Kadwa is a Devanagari typeface family designed by Sol Matas. It is based on the original Latin typeface Bitter, a slab serif typeface for text. People read and interact with text on screens more and more each day.

items.name: font-kaisei-decol
items.title: Kaisei Decol
items.description: Kaisei Decol is designed with the same element in Kanji, the little dot at the end of the stroke. When typesetted, because of this dot elements, it makes less stimulus to eyes and also gives a cute and fun impression.

items.name: font-kaisei-harunoumi
items.title: Kaisei HarunoUmi
items.description: Kaisei Haru No Umi's Kana is an organic wavy design that gives natural and friendly look. Katakana is designed slightly smaller to give more old-style typesetting impression. Better when set in text size.

items.name: font-kaisei-opti
items.title: Kaisei Opti
items.description: Kaisei Opti is a modern style Japanese typeface. When typesetted, it gives a cheerful and breezy impression. To contribute to the project, visit https://github.com/FontKai-Kaisei/Kaisei

items.name: font-kaisei-tokumin
items.title: Kaisei Tokumin
items.description: Kaisei Tokumin is a shorten word for Tokudai Mincho Kana, meaning "Extra Bold Serif Kana," intended for the strong title usage.

items.name: font-kalam
items.title: Kalam
items.description: Kalam is a handwriting-style typeface supporting the Devanagari and Latin scripts. This is an Open Source font family first published by the Indian Type Foundry in 2014.

items.name: font-kalnia
items.title: Kalnia
items.description: Kalnia, a serif typeface by Frida Medrano.

items.name: font-kalnia-glaze
items.title: Kalnia Glaze
items.description: Kalnia Glaze, a display typeface by Frida Medrano.

items.name: font-kameron
items.title: Kameron
items.description: Kameron is a reworking and fusing of several classic Slab Serif and Egyptian type forms from the early to mid Twentieth Century.

items.name: font-kanchenjunga
items.title: Kanchenjunga
items.description: Kanchenjunga, a sans typeface by Becca Hirsbrunner Spalinger.

items.name: font-kanit
items.title: Kanit
items.description: Kanit means mathematics in Thai, and the Kanit typeface family is a formal Loopless Thai and Sans Latin design. It is a combination of concepts, mixing a Humanist Sans Serif motif with the curves of Capsulated Geometric styles that makes...

items.name: font-kantumruy-pro
items.title: Kantumruy Pro
items.description: Kantumruy Pro is a newly redrawn design of the first Kantumruy (published in 2013) which is a modern display Khmer typeface that is being used by small and big brands in Cambodia, as well as many non-profit organizations for their visual...

items.name: font-kapakana
items.title: Kapakana
items.description: Kapakana is a Kana typeface designed with the concept of a copperplate script, including Hiragana, Katakana, and Latin glyphs (for pinyin use). It is a two weight font and available both as static instances and as a variable font.

items.name: font-karantina
items.title: Karantina
items.description: Karantina is a Hebrew and Latin typeface family. It was created by Rony Koch during the long days of COVID-19 quarantine. Karantina is a three weight family that includes - Light, Regular and Bold.

items.name: font-karla
items.title: Karla
items.description: Karla is a grotesque sans serif family which has been expanded now to a variable font with a weight axis ranging from ExtraLight to ExtraBold plus full support of Western, Central, and South-Eastern European languages.

items.name: font-karma
items.title: Karma
items.description: Karma is an Open Source multi-script typeface supporting both the Devanagari and the Latin script. The family was developed for use in body text on screen, and five fonts are available.

items.name: font-katibeh
items.title: Katibeh
items.description: Katibeh is a headline font based on the Naskh script, infused with some qualities of the Thuluth script. The small serif-like outstrokes make Katibeh remind us of archaic designs, but other aspects of the design are very contemporary...

items.name: font-kaushan-script
items.title: Kaushan Script
items.description: When making digital typefaces, the more you refine the shapes of the letters, the more energy you take away from them. Because of that, Kaushan Script is unrefined - and carries a lot of energy.

items.name: font-kavivanar
items.title: Kavivanar
items.description: Kavivanar is a unique handwriting font that supports the Tamil and Latin scripts. It is somewhat bold, and slightly slanted, a typical Tamil handwriting style where an incline is popular.

items.name: font-kavoon
items.title: Kavoon
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Kavoon is a display face based on experiments with brush and ink. Kavoon's expressive features make words vivid and powerfully draw the reader in. Kavoon may be used from medium to large sizes.

items.name: font-kay-pho-du
items.title: Kay Pho Du
items.description: Kay Pho Du is a font family for the Kayah Li script, based initially on the design of Karenni, although the glyphs have been redrawn and a new Latin set has been added. It supports the full Kayah Li range of Unicode characters.

items.name: font-kdam-thmor-pro
items.title: Kdam Thmor Pro
items.description: Kdam Thmor Pro is a revised design of "Kdam Thmor" which is one of Sovichet Tep's typefaces designed and published back in 2013 on Google Fonts.

items.name: font-keania-one
items.title: Keania One
items.description: Keania is a re-development of Kenia. As a stencil font its idea stems from experiences of travel and life in Kenya, especially from the large lettering seen on shop fronts and market stands.

items.name: font-kedebideri
items.title: Kedebideri
items.description: Kedebideri, a sans typeface by SIL International.

items.name: font-kelly-slab
items.title: Kelly Slab
items.description: Kelly Slab is a new geometric, modern-looking slab-serif font. Created under the influence of popular geometric fonts from the 1930s with square slabserifs, such as "City" by Georg Trump.

items.name: font-kenia
items.title: Kenia
items.description: Inspired by travel and my stay in Kenya, I would fill my days with sketches and lettering. From there Kenia evolved as a stencil display font.

items.name: font-khand
items.title: Khand
items.description: Khand is a family of compact mono-linear fonts with very open counter forms. Developed for display typography, the family is primarily intended for headline usage.

items.name: font-khula
items.title: Khula
items.description: Khula (खुला) is a contemporary text Devanagari typeface family designed by Erin McLaughlin as a compliment to Open Sans, a Latin family designed by Steve Matteson. Currently it has 5 weights and supports Hindi.

items.name: font-kings
items.title: Kings
items.description: Imagine a damsel in distress. The only hope is for the Kings Knights to rescue her from certain death. Kings Family is based on the three set font family (Kings Honor, Kings Quest and Kings Dominion).

items.name: font-kirang-haerang
items.title: Kirang Haerang
items.description: Kirang Haerang is a Korean and Latin font

items.name: font-kite-one
items.title: Kite One
items.description: Kite One is a rounded, monoline, humanist sans serif typeface. With an inclination of 7 degrees, it gives a fluid reading experience.

items.name: font-kiwi-maru
items.title: Kiwi Maru
items.description: Kiwi Maru was created mainly for use in digital devices, and I hope you will use it experimentally in your papers and reports.

items.name: font-klee-one
items.title: Klee One
items.description: Klee is a script font handwritten by pencil or pen. Its quiet design has an elegant look that sets itself apart from traditional script and textbook fonts. Ideal for body text.

items.name: font-knewave
items.title: Knewave
items.description: Knewave is a new font by Tyler Finck.

items.name: font-kodchasan
items.title: Kodchasan
items.description: Kodchasan is a Thai and Latin family inspired by teenage handwriting. It has a casual appearance which works well for content aimed at adolescents.

items.name: font-kode-mono
items.title: Kode Mono
items.description: Kode Mono is a variable monospaced typeface designed specifically for the developer community. Its key feature is clarity and functionality, making it ideal for coding environments where legibility is crucial.

items.name: font-koh-santepheap
items.title: Koh Santepheap
items.description: Koh Santepheap is a Khmer font for body text, that pairs well with Latin serif fonts and for bilingual (English - Khmer) text. To contribute, see github.com/danhhong/KohSantepheap.

items.name: font-koho
items.title: KoHo
items.description: KoHo is a Thai and Latin family inspired by geometric and humanist san serifs. The letterforms appear neither too mechanical or too calligraphic.

items.name: font-kolker-brush
items.title: Kolker Brush
items.description: Kolker Brush is a weighty hand lettered brush script. As with any script, it is never recommended to use all caps when editing copy. Use Kolker Brush for situations that require a bit of punch.

items.name: font-konkhmer-sleokchher
items.title: Konkhmer Sleokchher
items.description: Konkhmer Sleokchher is created and released in 2015 by Suon May Sophanith. It is a modern display Khmer font, inspired by the brush strokes used for writing on walls, but expressed as leaves.

items.name: font-kosugi
items.title: Kosugi
items.description: Kosugi is a Gothic design, with low stroke contrast and monospaced metrics. Initially developed by MOTOYA and released for the Android platform under the Apache license, the typeface is based on a design from the 1950s.

items.name: font-kosugi-maru
items.title: Kosugi Maru
items.description: Kosugi Maru is a Gothic Rounded design, with low stroke contrast and monospaced metrics, and rounded terminals. Initially developed by MOTOYA and released for the Android platform under the Apache license, the typeface is based on a design...

items.name: font-kotta-one
items.title: Kotta One
items.description: Kotta One is a new and unusual text typeface that mixes the characteristics of an italic with legibility of a roman. Kotta uses a true calligraphic construction, with a structure based on a real italic hand, not simple mechanical slanted...

items.name: font-koulen
items.title: Koulen
items.description: Koulen is a Khmer font for headlines, titles and subtitles, and even banner designs. To contribute, see github.com/danhhong/Koulen.

items.name: font-kranky
items.title: Kranky
items.description: Kranky is a hand-crafted, fun-filled font.

items.name: font-kreon
items.title: Kreon
items.description: Kreon targets text typesetting for magazines and news sites. With a slight slab-serif look and the low contrast design, it is a sturdy typeface for your website, blog or online magazine.

items.name: font-kripa
items.title: Kripa
items.description: Kripa, a sans typeface by Kedar Gadge.

items.name: font-kristi
items.title: Kristi
items.description: Kristi is a calligraphy font inspired by old chancery typefaces. It is made with a basic felt-pen by using bold and quick moves while writing. The name of the font is a common Estonian girls name.

items.name: font-krona-one
items.title: Krona One
items.description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Krona is a low contrast semi-extended style sans serif. Krona is both readable and full of personality. Krona can be used from small sizes to larger display settings.

items.name: font-krub
items.title: Krub
items.description: Krub is a Thai and Latin text face with a twist. It uses the modern structure of Thai's traditional looped letterforms and blends it seamlessly with elements taken from the metal type era.

items.name: font-kufam
items.title: Kufam
items.description: Kufam is an Arabic-Latin bilingual typeface intended for contemporary information design such as signage and wayfinding systems. Kufam Arabic is inspired by 7th-century Kufi inscriptions.

items.name: font-kulim-park
items.title: Kulim Park
items.description: Kulim Park is a sans serif typeface, with high x-height, open counter 'a', minimal degrees of contrast in stem width, inviting bowls and a design language aimed at encapsulating openness.

items.name: font-kumar-one
items.title: Kumar One
items.description: Kumar is a series of matching Open Source display fonts. They each support the Gujarati and Latin scripts. The two Kumar fonts may be used together, or entirely on their own.

items.name: font-kumbh-sans
items.title: Kumbh Sans
items.description: Kumbh Sans is a Geometric Sans Serif font envisioned to serve as a multi-purpose and workhorse font in modern web and mobile applications. The anatomy is geometric with slight contrast.

items.name: font-kurale
items.title: Kurale
items.description: Kurale is a Latin, Cyrillic and Devanagari typeface derived from Gabriela. The Latin and Cyrillic serif typeface with soft shapes, and special terminal forms which are shaped like curls.

items.name: font-la-belle-aurore
items.title: La Belle Aurore
items.description: This whimsical, romantic handwriting is inspired by the romance of Casablanca. It is not a true script, but has many curls and tendrils similar to a script font.

items.name: font-labrada
items.title: Labrada
items.description: Labrada is a typeface family designed by Mercedes Jáuregui that expresses the communicative richness of the conversations and discourses of the indigenous cultures of oral tradition, at the same time that it dialogues with the classic...

items.name: font-lacquer
items.title: Lacquer
items.description: Lacquer is an expressive display font featuring heavy drips and dozens of alternate glyphs. Lacquer was hand drawn using a paint pen by Niki Polyocan and was extrapolated and finished by Eli Block at Google Creative Lab.

items.name: font-laila
items.title: Laila
items.description: Laila is an informal sans serif design with brush terminals. It has a very contemporary, 21st century appearance. Text set in Laila appears friendly, or even cute! Laila looks especially good in headlines.

items.name: font-lakki-reddy
items.title: Lakki Reddy
items.description: Lakki Reddy is a Telugu display typeface, mainly suitable for headings, posters and decorative invitations. Use it anywhere you want to use a handwriting style to add informality and personality to your text.

items.name: font-lalezar
items.title: Lalezar
items.description: Lalezar is an Arabic and Latin display typeface for popular culture. During the 1960s and 1970s a genre of filmmaking emerged in Iran which was commonly known as Film-Farsi.

items.name: font-lancelot
items.title: Lancelot
items.description: Lancelot is a new ornate serif type based on French traditions. It has two sets of capitals, swash and classical.

items.name: font-langar
items.title: Langar
items.description: Langar is a one-weight Latin/Gurmukhi display font based on informal, playful letterforms. It broadly follows the ‘upright-italic’ style of Latin fonts, experimenting with and introducing a similar style for the Gurmukhi script.

items.name: font-lateef
items.title: Lateef
items.description: Lateef, an extended Arabic font, is named after Shah Abdul Lateef Bhitai, the famous Sindhi mystic and poet. It is intended to be an appropriate style for use in Sindhi and other languages of the South Asian region.

items.name: font-lato
items.title: Lato
items.description: Lato means “Summer” in Polish, and it is a sans serif typeface family started in the summer of 2010 by Warsaw-based designer Łukasz Dziedzic.

items.name: font-lavishly-yours
items.title: Lavishly Yours
items.description: One of the first fonts to use ornately embellished capital forms, Lavishly Yours is a charming calligraphic script. Its nearly upright style along with looped lowercase miniscules gives this font a fairly tale look.

items.name: font-league-gothic
items.title: League Gothic
items.description: League Gothic is a revival of an old classic: Alternate Gothic. It was originally designed by Morris Fuller Bentonfor the American Type Founders Company in 1903.

items.name: font-league-script
items.title: League Script
items.description: This ain’t no Lucida. League Script is a modern, coquettish script font that sits somewhere between your high school girlfriend’s love notes and handwritten letters from the ’20s.

items.name: font-league-spartan
items.title: League Spartan
items.description: League Spartan is The League Of Moveable Type's interpretation of Matt Bailey's Spartan, a typeface based on early 20th century American geometric sans serifs. To contribute, see github.com/theleagueof/league-spartan.

items.name: font-leckerli-one
items.title: Leckerli One
items.description: Leckerli is your new fat friend for any display-fun! Its irregular brush shapes indulge you with their sweet character and cheering loops. It is also useful for shorter texts.

items.name: font-ledger
items.title: Ledger
items.description: The austere and concise personality and flexibility make it a real multiple-purpose typeface. The letter forms are distinguished by a large x-height, sufficient stroke contrast, robust but elegant wedge-like serifs and terminals.

items.name: font-lekton
items.title: Lekton
items.description: Lekton has been designed at ISIA Urbino, Italy, and is inspired by some of the typefaces used on the Olivetti typewriters.

items.name: font-lemon
items.title: Lemon
items.description: Lemon is a display typeface with soft and fluid shapes that come from painted street shop signage. The dark weight is ideal for headlines and short texts, and a future release of a lighter weight could be useful for longer text.

items.name: font-lemonada
items.title: Lemonada
items.description: Lemonada is a modern Arabic and Latin typeface family designed by Mohamed Gaber and Eduardo Tunni. It started with the Latin design Lemon, which Eduardo Tunni expanded to four weights. The Arabic was designed by Mohamed Gaber.

items.name: font-lexend
items.title: Lexend
items.description: Lexend fonts are intended to reduce visual stress and so improve reading performance. Initially they were designed with dyslexia and struggling readers in mind, but Bonnie Shaver-Troup, creator of the Lexend project, soon found out that...

items.title: Lexend Deca
items.description: Lexend is a collection of seven font families intended to improve reading proficiency. As prescription eyeglasses achieve proficiency for persons with short-sightedness, Lexend's families were developed using Shaver-Troup Formulations.
